public_rationale: The spending part holds. Amazon's CEO guided to about $75 billion of capex for 2024, mostly for AWS and driven by generative AI. The adoption part has evidence on both sides. Census data show only about 5% of US firms using AI to produce goods or services in 2024, which supports 'not happening at scale' across the economy. But Microsoft said in October 2024 that nearly 70% of the Fortune 500 used Microsoft 365 Copilot, and McKinsey's 2024 survey found 65% of respondents' organizations regularly used generative AI. So among large enterprises, the evidence points the other way. Overall the claim is mixed.
limitations: The $75B is guidance, not the audited actual.
Microsoft's figure is a vendor claim that counts any use, not deep integration.
Census counts any AI, not only generative AI.
The McKinsey figure comes from a news report.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Big tech has spent billions on data centers for generative AI, but business integration of generative AI does not appear to be happening at scale.

statement.excerpt: Every single big tech company has thrown billions — as much as $75 billion in Amazon's case in 2024 alone — at building the data centers and acquiring the GPUs to populate said data centers specifically so they can train their models or other companies' models, or serve customers that would integrate generative AI into their businesses, something that does not appear to be happening at scale.

our_interpretation: Two parts. (1) Big tech, with Amazon at up to about $75B in 2024, spent billions on data centers and GPUs, largely for generative AI. (2) Business integration of generative AI did not appear to be happening at scale.
The period is 2024 up to the post date, which matches his '2024 alone' and his present-tense description.
'At scale' is read plainly: broad deployment across businesses, not pilots at a small share of firms.
criteria.support_condition: Disclosures show 2024 capex of tens of billions, with Amazon near $75B and tied to generative AI, and 2024 adoption data show low business integration of generative AI.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Amazon's 2024 capex was far below the stated figure or not tied to AI, or 2024 data show broad business integration of generative AI.
